assumption_to_test: A minimal provider-neutral schema can classify unchanged, material, unverified, and recovered policy state from frozen refs without claiming live observation truth.
smallest_testable_validation: Extend the qif-ledger example and verifier with one approved baseline, repeated observations, a material drift assessment, an emergency demotion record, and retained negative fixtures.
expected_learning: Whether state lineage, severity, authority, evidence, and reconciliation rules are sufficient and deterministically testable.
expected_cost: One bounded schema-verifier-documentation release with no external integration.
success_threshold: All new negative fixtures fail for the intended reason, existing fixtures remain green, portable build succeeds, and verifier boundaries explicitly deny live execution and semantic truth.
